text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On New Year's Day, while lounging around 
spending a lazy holiday—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer. Are you there?
choice_data_list: Light O?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I instinctively checked the calendar. But 
it was a day off. Training with her wasn't 
supposed to start until the first day of 
the semester. Could it be some kind of 
emergency?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Your bedhead is crazy. Can I take a photo? 
I wanna show Durandal too.
choice_data_list: Absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Tch. Here's a souvenir from my trip home. 
Take it."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much for taking care of my 
daughter. This is just a small token of 
gratitude. It's completely legal. Please 
accept it," said my father.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Is there something suspicious in it? Or 
was the explanation simply very detailed? 
For now, I'll gratefully accept it.
choice_data_list:
You could have waited until after the 
break, though.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"My parents said greetings are best done 
early. So, I came as fast as I could."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Could you give me an assignment?
choice_data_list: Challenges? Do you mean the training menu?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I do not wish to waste a single 
minute or second.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An admirable mindset. It must stem from 
your fierce desire to reach peak speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list:
Then let's challenge a proper New Year's 
task.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What kind of task would be fitting for New 
Year's?
choice_data_list: Let's pound some mochi!
Let's go to the New Year's buffet.
How about Umamusume Karuta?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they're holding it in the shopping 
district. The "Friendly Mochi-Pounding 
Festival."
choice_data_list:
Thrusting practice should make for good 
training.

Thrusting practice should make for good 
training.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, getting to eat mochi too makes it 
killing two birds with one stone. Ah, I'll 
make sure Trainer gets some too."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Light O-san! Could you be taking part 
in the mochi-pounding festival?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Helpful Umamusume Kitasan Black called 
out. It seemed she was helping out with 
the 'Community Mochi-Pounding Event.'

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That's right. I want to be the pounder.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yay, you're a lifesaver! We were in 
trouble without someone to pound the 
mochi.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to it! I'll handle 
flipping the mochi!
choice_data_list: It might be hard to make them as a pair...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O is guaranteed to pound 
mochi fast. I've never seen it, but it's 
definitely fast. No ordinary mochi-turner 
could ever keep up with that speed.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case, could you accompany 
me for just a little bit? If it looks 
impossible, I'll give up.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Understood. —I shall borrow the mallet.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Here I go— 
Hmph-hmph-hmph-hmph-hm-hm-hm-hm-hm-hm-hmph!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Uhyaa, you're seriously fast! But still...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I think I can return this! Light O's 
rhythm was so clear, and keeping to a beat 
is my specialty!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
You think you can keep up with my speed? 
Interesting. Let's see you try.

text_block_list.name: Right O & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Ready, and!

text_block_list.name: Right O & Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Hum-hum-hum-hum-hum-hum-hum-hum-humph! 
Take that take that take that 
ta-ta-ta-ta-yah!
choice_data_list: S-So fast...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, look at that mochi pounding! It's 
so fast... I can't even see their hands!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! You big sisters are amazing! Just 
like a mochi-pounding machine!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, Kitasan. Working together was 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Same here! The mochi turned out super soft 
and stretchy too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's hand them out to the guests right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Calstone Light O and Kitasan 
Black's high-speed mochi pounding brought 
great joy to the shopping district's 
customers.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Does it feel like New Year's to you? You 
just want to eat it, don't you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Ugh... I got sick of cup noodles, too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Your diet is completely ruined. This won't 
do. Let's get you some proper nutrition at 
the buffet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
May I take a photo of the food? I'd also 
like to post it on Umastagram.

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Server
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~, Curren-chan!? So cute! Of course 
you can take pictures and post them to 
Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the hotel restaurant buffet. I spotted 
Curren Chan there, taking pictures of the 
dishes laid out.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the plating's kind of ruined... It 
feels wrong to post it like this.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Curren. Is that spot open?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Right O-san! Sorry, I didn't notice 
you. Go right ahead.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
This square aspic looks delicious. Above 
all, its shape is wonderful. I shall have 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O took some aspic and lined 
it up on her plate. In a perfectly 
straight line.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, you plated it so well! It looks 
just like when it was first served!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Um, Light O-san, would it be okay if I 
took a photo of your plate?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"This aspic is so cute, I just had to post 
it on Umastagram!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Ehe, I'm so happy~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then let me take a picture at our table. 
Since we're here, let's eat together.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes. Is Trainer okay with it too?
choice_data_list: Of course, with pleasure!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Right O-san, you plated everything 
in a straight line! That's so cute~!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, isn't it cute? Straight lines are 
beautiful and cute.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, let's take a selfie together to 
commemorate how cute it is!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yes! And on the straight~?

text_block_list.name: Right O & Curren
text_block_list.text: Cute! So cute.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O had a delightful time at 
the buffet with Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Are we doing this? Umamusume Karuta. 
Contesting giant cards... between you and 
me, Trainer. You certainly have a death 
wish."
choice_data_list: It's an Umamusume karuta tournament!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, there should be a tournament 
being held nearby. Of course, we can't 
participate, but they have a hands-on 
karuta corner set up.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. Catch a stray Umamusume and make 
her my sparring partner. That's what you 
mean, right?
choice_data_list:
That's true, but you could've worded it 
better...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Karuta is also a contest of speed. It 
seems like it would make for good 
exercise.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you trying out karuta too, Light 
O-san? Let's definitely play together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'm only here for the participation gift 
money, so please go easy on me~."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please do the honors of being the 
reader.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fortune-loving Umamusume 
Matikanefukukitaru and the totally average 
Umamusume Hishi Miracle agreed to play 
karuta with me.
choice_data_list:
"On this tranquil spring day of eternal 
light..."

text_block_list.name: Right O & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes! Uh, uh, uh... found it! Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaah! A foul! I grabbed the wrong card 
starting with "O"!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Got the "Hi" card! I win.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-san, you committed a foul too, 
didn't you! The second half of the poem 
is: 'So gently, so calm, the cherry 
blossom buds'!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "The concluding hemistich"? What's that?
choice_data_list:
Sorry, looks like they don't know the 
rules...

Sorry, looks like I don't know the 
rules...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume Karuta uses the "Ogura Hyakunin 
Isshu." You read the first half of the 
poem, and take the card with the second 
half. The second half is read aloud in the 
latter part.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. In that case, how about you read 
the second half of the poem, and we play 
like regular karuta!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll leave it to you, then.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
By the way, the correct answer is: I ate 
it~ Sneaky me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So you two made a false start, which means 
you skip a turn, right? Yay~ Guess I'll 
take the next one too~

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, we're in a pinch right out of the 
gate...! Not bad, Mira-ko.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-chan, you're way too fast~. How 
about listening carefully to the reader 
before making your move?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Slowly." That is what I am worst at. 
However, if that is the trick, I shall 
endure and try it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, through karuta, Calstone Light O 
learned to wait just a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I headed to the academy's 
Trainer's office. I had remembered there 
was a TV special covering the Twinkle 
Series.

text_block_list.name: TV Program Host
text_block_list.text:
Next up is a special feature: 'Road to the 
Crown'!

text_block_list.name: TV Program Host
text_block_list.text:
"We'd like to introduce the Umamusume 
expected to shine in the upcoming spring 
Classic campaign. First up is this 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: TV Program Host
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon! A complete victory in her 
debut, followed by yet another in the 
graded stakes race.

text_block_list.name: TV Program Host
text_block_list.text:
Setting aside her exceptional talent, her 
greatest asset is her flawless race 
management.

text_block_list.name: TV Program Host
text_block_list.text:
True to her name, her running is just like 
light itself! She is the foremost favorite 
for the Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"A tachyon is a hypothetical particle that 
always travels faster than the speed of 
light."
choice_data_list: W-What is it? So suddenly...
W-What's wrong? So suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That is what my mother taught me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Tachyon told me before: to go ask Mother.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It looks like we're debuting in the same 
year. We're classmates of the same class, 
so to speak.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you and I share quite a curious 
bond. Perhaps it's because we're so alike?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Are we similar?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"You are similar. Especially with the 
madness you harbor behind your eyes."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Those are the eyes of one captivated by 
the light, one who has devoted everything 
to it. You, and me both."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it's fate, bearing 'Light' in 
my name.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Light in the name... Which part? 'Gnes'? 
'Nesta'? Or maybe 'Stachy'?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Why not ask your mother? It ought 
to be her area of expertise.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's a refreshing, youthful episode about 
Tachyon and me.
choice_data_list:
So it wasn't totally unrefreshing after 
all!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, I've felt a bit closer to 
Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The world Tachyon sees must be similar to 
the world I'm aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That might very well be true. I've heard 
Agnes Tachyon continues her research in 
pursuit of pure speed as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, when it comes to their running, 
the two are polar opposites. While 
Calstone Light O pursues nothing but pure 
speed—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon is utterly flawless in every 
aspect. There is not a single opening in 
her running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, she is the top contender for 
the Classic Triple Crown. And without 
running at that level, one cannot win 
through the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Is something wrong?
choice_data_list: ...No, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A small feeling of unease arises in my 
chest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Can she truly advance to victory on speed 
alone?
